versions.subject: rule: disable volume snaptshots
versions.detection:
selection:

        - 'reg'
        - ' add '
        - '\Services\VSS\Diag' 
        - '/d Disabled'
condition: selection
versions.spl: CommandLine="*reg*" CommandLine="* add *" CommandLine="*\\Services\\VSS\\Diag*" CommandLine="*/d Disabled*"
